sentences.english: As a container reaches Rotterdam after its voyage from Yantian, the team is already preparing its onward journey to Eindhoven.
sentences.dutch: Een container uit Yantian bereikt Rotterdam. Het team bereidt de reis naar Eindhoven voor.

sentences.english: In the CargoMatch demo, they bring the shipment and its documents together, so everyone can follow what needs to happen next.
sentences.dutch: In de CargoMatch-demo komen zending en documenten samen, zodat iedereen de volgende stap kan volgen.

sentences.english: But before they move ahead, a small detail needs attention: the documents show a weight difference of one hundred and eighty kilograms.
sentences.dutch: Eerst vraagt een detail aandacht: de documenten tonen een gewichtsverschil van 180 kilogram.

sentences.english: Rather than letting that discrepancy travel further down the chain, a colleague checks the source and records the reviewed weight.
sentences.dutch: Een collega controleert de bron en legt het beoordeelde gewicht vast, vóór de afwijking doorwerkt.

sentences.english: The original documents remain in the dossier, while each partner sees the information their role allows.
sentences.dutch: De oorspronkelijke documenten blijven bewaard. Elke partner ziet wat bij zijn rol hoort.

sentences.english: With that context in place, the customs specialist can review the dossier and its requirements before deciding how to proceed.
sentences.dutch: Met die informatie beoordeelt de douanespecialist het dossier en de vereisten voor de volgende stap.

sentences.english: The process here is simulated, so no real declaration is submitted, but the handover still makes clear who has checked what.
sentences.dutch: Dit proces is gesimuleerd, zonder echte aangifte. De overdracht toont wel wie wat heeft gecontroleerd.

sentences.english: That same visibility carries into the costs, which total ninety-five thousand seven hundred and seven euros in this China example.
sentences.dutch: Ook de kosten zijn zichtbaar: in dit China-voorbeeld samen 95.707 euro.

sentences.english: By reviewing those charges alongside the release conditions, the team can see what remains outstanding before collection.
sentences.dutch: Kosten en vrijgavevoorwaarden tonen samen wat vóór het ophalen nog moet gebeuren.

sentences.english: Payments and release are simulated too; the demonstration moves the process forward without moving real money.
sentences.dutch: Ook betaling en vrijgave zijn gesimuleerd: het proces gaat verder, zonder echt geld te verplaatsen.

sentences.english: Once those conditions are satisfied, attention turns to the journey beyond the port, where suitable transport options help the planner start a conversation.
sentences.dutch: Daarna verschuift de aandacht naar het achterland. Passende vervoeropties helpen de planner op weg.

sentences.english: Both parties choose whether to connect, knowing that this introduction is not a booking.
sentences.dutch: Beide partijen kiezen of ze verbinden. Die kennismaking is geen boeking.

sentences.english: They still need to agree the practical arrangements, with planning and delivery handled as separate steps.
sentences.dutch: Praktische afspraken blijven nodig. Planning en aflevering zijn afzonderlijke stappen.

sentences.english: As the container continues towards the warehouse, its handover remains part of the same shipment story.
sentences.dutch: Op weg naar het magazijn blijft de overdracht onderdeel van hetzelfde zendingsdossier.

sentences.english: The approach also supports a smaller shipment travelling from Mumbai, through Rotterdam, to Tilburg.
sentences.dutch: Dezelfde aanpak helpt een deelzending van Mumbai via Rotterdam naar Tilburg.

sentences.english: Here, the receiver follows only their own house shipment, with their own documents, relevant charges and delivery choice, without seeing another receiver's business.
sentences.dutch: De ontvanger ziet alleen de eigen house-zending, documenten, kosten en afleverkeuze; geen andere dossiers.

sentences.english: And while these individual journeys unfold, the Control Tower keeps vessel status, route and arrival estimates in view, together with the source, time and any exceptions.
sentences.dutch: De Control Tower toont scheepsstatus, route, ETA en afwijkingen, steeds met bron en tijd.

sentences.english: This is synthetic demo tracking rather than live A I S, giving the team a shared picture while keeping its limits clear.
sentences.dutch: Dit is synthetische demotracking, geen live AIS: gedeeld overzicht met duidelijke grenzen.

sentences.english: From the first document check to the final handover, CargoMatch connects the journey while leaving people in control.
sentences.dutch: Van documentcontrole tot overdracht verbindt CargoMatch de reis, met mensen aan het roer.

sentences.english: Discover CargoMatch, the transport capacity intelligence network.
sentences.dutch: Ontdek CargoMatch, het netwerk voor transportcapaciteitsinformatie.

groups.recognizedText: As a container reaches Rotterdam after its voyage from Yantian, the team is already preparing its onward journey to Einthoven. In the cargo match demo, they bring the shipment and its documents together, so everyone can follow what needs to happen next. But before they move ahead, a small detail needs attention. The documents show a weight difference of 180 kilograms. Rather than letting that discrepancy travel further down the chain, a colleague checks the source and records the reviewed weight. The original documents remain in the dossier, while each partner sees the information their role allows. With that context in place, the custom specialist can review the dossier and its requirements before deciding how to proceed. The process here is simulated, so no real declaration is submitted, but the handover still makes clear who has checked what. That same visibility carries into the costs, which total 95,707 euros in this China example. By reviewing those charges alongside the release conditions, the team can see what remains outstanding before collection. Payments and release are simulated too. The demonstration moves the process forward without moving real money. Once those conditions are satisfied, attention turns to the journey beyond the port, where suitable transport options help the planner start a conversation. Both parties choose whether to connect, knowing that this introduction is not a booking. They still need to agree the practical arrangements with planning and delivery handled as separate steps. As the container continues towards the warehouse, its handover remains part of the same shipment's story. The approach also supports a smaller shipment travelling from Mumbai, through Rotterdam, to Tilburg. Here, the receiver follows only their own house shipment, with their own documents relevant charges and delivery choice, without seeing another receiver's business. And while these individual journeys unfold, the control tower keeps vessel status, route and arrival estimates in view, together with the source, time and any exceptions. This is synthetic demo tracking, rather than live AIS, giving the team a shared picture while keeping its limits clear. From the first document check to the final handover, cargo match connects the journey while leaving people in control. Discover cargo match, the transport capacity intelligence network.
